responsibility: Provides the base ELF/System V.4 subtarget configuration for rs6000 PowerPC targets. It sets the object format, ABI-selection and small-data policy, defines the major SysV option-override logic for -mcall and -msdata variants, and contributes the broad cpp, assembler, linker, startup, profiling, EH, and multilib spec framework used by many downstream OS headers such as Linux, NetBSD, and VxWorks.
same_name_distinction: This is the C preprocessor/header implementation layer for the SysV4 rs6000 target: it consumes the SysV4 target variables and options, sets TARGET_USES_SYSV4_OPT, and turns them into ABI-selection logic, specs, and target macros used by downstream OS headers. Unlike sysv4.opt, it does not declare options; it interprets them to configure the backend and driver behavior.
